Our Services

Excellent technical and consulting services for key players in the Nigerian economy.

Electrical & Power Engineering

Design, installation and maintenance of electrical power systems for industrial, commercial and residential facilities.

  • Power distribution and electrical installations
  • Transformer and switchgear installation
  • Backup power and inverter systems
  • Preventive maintenance and fault diagnosis

Solar & Renewable Energy

Clean, reliable energy solutions that reduce running costs and dependence on the grid and diesel generators.

  • Solar PV system design and installation
  • Battery storage and hybrid systems
  • Energy audits and efficiency upgrades
  • System monitoring and maintenance

Mechanical & Industrial Services

Support for plants and factories to keep machinery running safely and efficiently.

  • Installation of industrial machinery
  • Planned and breakdown maintenance
  • Fabrication and component replacement
  • Plant inspection and reliability support

Electronics, Instrumentation & Control

Measurement, control and electronic systems that keep critical operations accurate and reliable.

  • Instrumentation installation and calibration
  • Control panels and automation
  • Telecommunications site support
  • Electronic equipment repair

Construction & Project Management

Planning and delivery of engineering projects, from site preparation through to handover.

  • Project planning, scheduling and costing
  • Site supervision and quality control
  • Contractor coordination
  • Health, safety and environment (HSE) management

Technical Consultancy

Independent engineering advice to help clients plan, specify and get the most from their investments.

  • Feasibility studies and technical assessments
  • Engineering design review
  • Procurement and specification support
  • Training and skills development
